info.title: Tacacs_Server
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

address.description:
Reference Resource: [Tacacs_Server](#/Tacacs_Server)
IPV4/IPV6 address or FQDN of the TACACS+ server.

auth_statistics.description: Contains key-value pairs that report the number of authentication packets communicated with the server.

auth_accepts.description: Number of Auth-Reply packets received from this server with status pass.

auth_challenge.description: Number of Auth-Reply packets received from this server asking for additional information.

auth_rejects.description: Number of Auth-Reply packets received from this server with status fail.

auth_reply_malformed.description: Number of malformed Auth-Reply packets received  from this server.

auth_start.description: Number of Auth-Start packets sent to this server.

dropped_pkt.description: Number of TACACS+ packets dropped from this server on the authentication port.

pending_requests.description: Number of Auth-Start packets destined for this server that have not yet timed out or received a response.

round_trip_time.description: Time interval between Auth-Start and the most recent Auth-Reply from this server.

timeout.description: Number of timed out Auth-Start packets destined for this server.

unknown_types.description: Number of TACACS+ packets of unknown type received from this server on the authentication port.

auth_type.description: Specifies the server specific authentication method (pap/chap) to be used. If not set, the globally configured authentication method (pap/chap) will be used.

default_group_priority.description: Specifies the order in which a TACACS+ server is configured within TACACS+ default family group 'tacacs' By default all TACACS+ servers should be added to default group 'tacacs' Priority is assigned starting with 1 and incremental. Servers with equal priority in the default family group will undergo similar tie-breaker algorithm as mentioned for the user defined server group

group.description:
Reference Resource: [AAA_Server_Group](#/AAA_Server_Group)
Specifies the TACACS+ server-group that it belongs to. This column is used to identify the user defined AAA server group this TACACS+ server belongs to

last_tracking_attempted_time.description: Time in seconds since Epoch when the most recent reachability tracking request was sent to the TACACS+ server.

last_tracking_status_changed_time.description: Time in seconds since Epoch when TACACS+ Server status last changed from reachable to unreachable or vice versa.

passkey.description: Specifies the shared secret key between the TACACS+ client and the TACACS+ server.  If not set, the globally configured passkey will be used.

reachability_status.description: Specifies the reachability of Configured TACACS+ Server. 'reachable':    tracking for this server is enabled and the                 server is reachable. 'unreachable':  tracking for this server is enabled and the                 server is not reachable. An empty value means the reachability of this server is unknown.

tcp_port.description:
Reference Resource: [Tacacs_Server](#/Tacacs_Server)
Specifies the tcp port number used for exchanging TACACS+ messages between the client and server.

timeout.description: Specifies the server specific timeout interval that the switch waits for response from the TACACS+ server before declaring a timeout failure. If not set, the globally configured timeout will be used.

tracking_enable.description: Specifies whether tracking should be enabled for this server (server tracking has to be enabled globally as well).

tracking_statistics.description: Contains key-value pairs that report the number of TACACS+ authentication START & REPLY packets that were communicated with the server for tracking purpose. These statistics will be updated periodically based on the global configuration tacacs_tracking_time_interval value.

authentication_requests.description: Number of TACACS+ authentication START packets sent to this server for tracking.

authentication_responses.description: Number of TACACS+ REPLY packets received from this server in response to tracking START packets

user_group_priority.description: Specifies the order in which TACACS+ servers are configured within a user defined server group. Priority is assigned starting with 1 and incremental. If not set, it means this server is not part of a user defined group, this will be empty. Servers where priority is not configured will be reached out last Servers with equal priority in a group will be reached out as follows: Those belonging to vrf where vrf_name appears alphabetically earlier than the others are reached out first. If that's a tie, servers with address appearing alphabetically earlier than the others is reached out first. If that too is a tie, servers with smaller tcp port are reached out first

vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [Tacacs_Server](#/Tacacs_Server)
Specifies the VRF to be used to connect to this server.

parameters.name: VRF.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF identifier. Should be alphanumeric. VRF names must be unique.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
